rem Inscribed Circles of Triangles with
rem One Angle of 60 Degrees
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=195
rem Count the integer sided triangles
rem with a 60 degree angle whose
rem inradius is at most Limit

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Limit integer = 1053779

rem Primitive triples z^2 = x^2 + x y +
rem y^2 come from m > n, with t = m - n
rem prime to n and not a multiple of 3.
rem The triangles (y, x + y, z) and
rem (x, x + y, z) have inradii
rem sqrt(3) / 2 n (n + t) and
rem sqrt(3) / 6 t (3 n + t). With bound
rem C, the multiples k fit when
rem 3 q^2 k^2 <= C^2, so a table of
rem isqrt(C^2 / (3 q^2)) gives the count
rem for every q at once.
Cb = 2 * Limit
Ca = 6 * Limit
Qb = (Cb * Cb // 3) isqrt
Qa = (Ca * Ca // 3) isqrt
Qs = 1 to Qb array
Rb' = Cb * Cb // (3 * Qs * Qs)
Tb = Rb isqrt copy
Qs = 1 to Qa array
Ra' = Ca * Ca // (3 * Qs * Qs)
Ta = Ra isqrt copy
Total = 0
for N in 1 to Qb
  if N * (N + 1) greater Qb
    break
  end
  Ts = 1 to (Qb // N - N) array
  Ok' = Ts mod 3 not equal 0 and (N gcd Ts) equal 1
  Qv' = N * (N + Ts)
  Hit' = Tb (Qv - 1) filter Ok
  Total += Hit sum
end
for T in 1 to Qa
  if T * (T + 3) greater Qa
    break
  end
  if T mod 3 not equal 0
    Ns = 1 to ((Qa // T - T) // 3) array
    Ok' = (Ns gcd T) equal 1
    Qv' = T * (3 * Ns + T)
    Hit' = Ta (Qv - 1) filter Ok
    Total += Hit sum
  end
end
Answer = Total
Answer print
